title: Grid Rush ( Relay Tic Tac Toe )
rules:
1. Game Setup:
    • The grid: A 3x3 grid with 9 hoops (4x4 for finals).
    • Straight line: A designated straight line approximately 20-30 feet away from the grid. Teams stand behind the marked line.
    • Markers: Each team gets 3 identical markers.
    • On the whistle, Player 1 runs, places a marker, returns, and tags Player 2.
    • Player 2 does the same, then tags Player 3.
    • Player 3 places the last marker and returns.
    • If no team gets 3 in a row, the next player in rotation (Player 1, 2, 3) continues the game in order.
    • Players move one of their own markers to an empty spot.
    • Tag the next player after returning. Continue until a team wins.
    • The Final round will be played on a 4x4 grid. The winning team must make 4 in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal).
  2. Round 1 - Online Round:
    • Each team should carry their own mobile device.
    • Each team will play 1 match of 5 rounds.
    • 1 single player from each team will be selected to play against their opponent.
    • Each player will get 3 seconds to make a move. If the time limit is exceeded and the player has not made a move, that player forfeits their move.
    • After every match, the other 2 team members have to play the next match until the game is completed.
    • Tournament follows a knockout format. If there is an odd number of teams, one team is chosen by lot to get a Bye (skips the round).
  3. Round 2 - Offline Round:
    • Each team consists of 3 players.
    • Each team will be assigned a specific colored marker.
    • Coin toss to decide which team starts first.
    • Tournament follows a knockout format. If there is an odd number of teams, one team is chosen by lot to get a Bye (skips the round).
    • The lot is repeated in later rounds if the number of teams is still odd.
    • Each match between 2 teams consists of exactly 3 rounds.
    • The team that wins the majority of rounds (best out of 3) wins and advances to the next stage of the bracket.
    • Position 3 markers in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal). Leave the grid untouched for the referee to check.
    • Each player will get fixed time in seconds (told before the game starts) to place a marker. If the time limit is exceeded and the player has not placed the marker, that player forfeits their move.
    • False Start: Run only after being tagged.
    • Touch Opponent's Marker: Round lost.
    • Disturb Grid: Intentional disturbance - Round lost.
